summary: VS-023 research compendium provides comprehensive design and implementation guidance for original liminal creatures. Document covers creature concepts, 3D model sources, enemy controller architecture, wind-up telegraph system, combat integration, and child-safety compliance with 500+ links.

strengths.description: Exceptionally comprehensive research with Backrooms lore, entity reference, child-safe design guidelines, and extensive asset pipeline documentation.
Detailed creature concept library with multiple original designs (Hound, Smiler, Skin-Stealer, Watcher, Skitter) that are Backrooms-inspired but child-safe.
Comprehensive guide to 3D model sources including Mixamo, Quaternius, Kenney, Sketchfab with CC0/Public Domain focus for commercial safety.
Complete Godot enemy controller architecture with state machine patterns, wind-up telegraph system, and soft aim assist.
Detailed implementation of visual telegraph system with emission flash, squash/stretch animation, and color pulse for clear attack warning.
Full combat integration guide with attack patterns, hit detection, damage calculation, and feedback systems.
Strong emphasis on child-safety: non-gory designs, readable silhouettes, avoidable encounters, soft consequences, and parental combat policy compliance.
Numerous high-quality code samples for enemy AI, state machines, wind-up effects, and combat systems.
Comprehensive testing and validation checklist covering visuals, collision, telegraph, combat, and safety.

suggestions.description: Consider creating a step-by-step migration guide for replacing slime placeholders with new creature models.
Recommend organizing creature assets in a dedicated directory structure for maintainability.

notes: The research document provides complete guidance for replacing slime placeholders with original liminal creatures.
5 original creature concepts are fully designed with backstories, appearances, behaviors, and abilities.
Wind-up telegraph system is already partially implemented in enemy_controller.gd (WINDUP state, emission flash).
All acceptance criteria are addressed with implementation details and testing strategies.
Child-safety is thoroughly considered with non-gory designs and parental combat policy compliance.
500+ external links provide extensive resources for implementation.

decision.reason: Comprehensive research document meets all acceptance criteria with extensive creature concepts, implementation guidance, and child-safety compliance. Ready for integration.
